content.comment_body: Hello! I'm exploring options to create a dedicated data logger using [product_name] PLC. My goal is to store values over a set period, such as one month, and then recycle them. According to the manual, it records values and creates a file with 20,000 lines on an SD card, but there's a limit of 50 files stored. Is there a way to automatically overwrite files, so only the newest 50 remain on the SD card? Any suggestions on how to address this? Can [version_no] overwrite data when the MMC card is full? Thank you.

No, the limitations of 20,000 lines per data log and a maximum of 50 data logs are fixed and cannot be changed. Overwriting files is not possible. For questions about the [version_no], you might want to post in the dedicated conference for that version.
Hi [user_name], please keep topics separate. Use your other thread focused on data log recycling for questions about [version_no]. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking to use [product_name] PLC for extended data logging but face fixed restrictions on file size and quantity, creating difficulties in continuous logging scenarios. The system does not support overwriting old files once the SD card reaches its file limit, which complicates automated data management and retention.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want an automatic method for [product_name] to overwrite or recycle old data log files, ensuring recent records are kept without manual action, similar to features found in more advanced PLCs.
